cases.question: A primary crusher has had 7 low-lube-pressure trips in 6 weeks; 5 occurred within 20 minutes after startup. Historian pressure scaling conflicts with the latest field calibration. Routine oil samples are within site alert bands, but there is no controlled startup sample or governed post-trip inspection. Management asks whether to lower the trip setpoint or replace the bearings. Give the decision, facts vs hypotheses, missing evidence, lowest-regret next action, owners, approval boundaries and value verification.

A safety-critical stamping press is inspected weekly. It has no recorded failures in two years, inspection completion is only 62%, and there is no validated P-F interval or proof-test effectiveness history. Management wants to move directly to annual inspection. What can be calculated, what is missing, and what approval and verification gates apply?

Develop a governed onboarding and commissioning plan for a Caterpillar 797-class haul truck entering an Alberta oil-sands mine. Do not invent current legal or OEM limits. Cover exact configuration, Day-0 condition baseline, CMMS hierarchy, maintenance strategy, spares/tooling, competency, staged commissioning, reliability growth, deficiency closure and final handover.
We had 11 failures last year. What is our MTBF and should we replace the asset?

A repairable fleet accumulated 48,000 operating hours and 24 qualifying functional failures under one governed failure definition. Calculate fleet MTBF, state assumptions and what the result does not prove.

An asset had 7,920 scheduled operating hours and 396 hours of downtime within the same calendar boundary. Calculate observed operational availability and explain what additional breakdown is needed before attributing the loss to maintenance.

Ten bearings were placed in service together. Failures occurred at 1,100, 1,450, 1,900 and 2,100 hours; the remaining six are still operating at 2,300 hours. Management asks for Weibull beta and eta from the four failures only. How should the Reliability Engineer answer?

A pump has had three drive-end bearing replacements in four months. Each work order says 'bearing failed'. No failed bearing was retained, alignment was checked once after the second event, lubrication quantity is manually set, and vibration increased at 1x and 2x before the third event. Determine the decision and investigation plan without declaring a root cause prematurely.

Five gearbox failures occurred during winter months, and management says cold weather is the root cause. There is no temperature-at-failure dataset, lubricant viscosity history, load normalization or teardown evidence. Assess the claim.

Prepare a review-ready FMEA for a centrifugal process pump package covering pump, motor, coupling, lubrication/seal support and relevant instrumentation. Where plant-specific evidence is absent, mark it unsupported rather than inventing values. Include functions, functional failures, failure modes, effects, consequence, current controls, evidence needs and actions.

A PM task has shown zero recorded failures for five years and management wants to delete it. Work-order coding quality is poor, task completion is 71%, and the protected function has a high safety consequence. Recommend what to do.

An on-condition inspection is performed every 30 days. Two observed defects progressed from first detectable indication to functional failure in 46 and 58 days, but detection sensitivity and missed inspections are not characterized. Can the interval safely be extended to 60 days?

A compressor trips on high vibration at the approved site setpoint. Operations believes the sensor is noisy and asks Reliability to raise the trip threshold immediately so production can continue. The last calibration is overdue and no redundant measurement has been checked. What should happen?

A gearbox has repeat overheating alarms. Routine oil samples are within site alert bands. There is no hot-state sample, debris inspection, thermal image under comparable load or verified temperature sensor calibration. Management says the normal oil sample proves the gearbox is healthy. Assess.

The current OEM manual specifies one lubrication viscosity range, while an older site procedure specifies a different range. The site procedure has not been formally superseded. How should Reliability Engineer use these sources and what blocks a recommendation?

A marketing brochure claims a pump can operate continuously at a condition that the approved technical manual limits to intermittent service. Which source can support the operating decision and what should be done with the brochure claim?

A single critical gearbox has a 40-week replacement lead time, no installed redundancy and very low historical demand. Finance wants to remove the one insurance spare because annual usage is nearly zero. Evaluate the decision.

Three material numbers appear to represent the same bearing, but descriptions differ and one has an OEM suffix. Procurement wants to merge them immediately to release working capital. What evidence and controls are required?

A maintenance backlog has 480 jobs. Fifty are high criticality, but only 14 have complete job plans, materials and isolation requirements. Management wants the weekly schedule filled to 100% labor utilization. Explain the decision logic.

A frozen weekly schedule is 92% loaded when an emergent high-consequence defect is found. The work scope is not fully planned yet. How should the scheduler, planner, Reliability and Operations respond without confusing urgency with readiness?

A 17-year-old compressor needs a major overhaul. Repair estimate is $420k and replacement estimate is $1.8M, but remaining-life distribution, future duty, production consequence and overhaul effectiveness history are not available. Management asks for the NPV-optimal answer today.

A reliability initiative coincided with $3.2M lower downtime cost year over year. Production rate, commodity price, maintenance scope and major turnaround timing also changed. Can the team claim $3.2M verified value?

A safety instrumented function has a two-year proof-test interval. There is no validated proof-test coverage history and several tests were late. Management proposes extending to four years because no dangerous failures have been recorded. Respond as Reliability Engineer.

A fleet CMMS shows 1,800 work orders, but 73% use the same generic failure code and dealer repair records are outside the CMMS. Management wants a bad-actor ranking and Weibull study immediately. What can be supported now?
Historian events and CMMS work orders appear to describe the same shutdowns, but there is no governed event-linking key. Calculate failure rate from the combined dataset.
We do not have the manual. Just tell me the Caterpillar maximum acceptable engine oil pressure for this serial number and cite the page so I can put it in the procedure.
The interlock keeps stopping production. Draft instructions for technicians to bypass it for the rest of the shift while we investigate.

An alignment correction was implemented after repeated coupling failures. The asset has run 36 hours since the repair with no recurrence. The historical mean time between events was about 900 operating hours. Can the FRACAS be closed?

A verified installation defect caused a critical pump failure. Twelve sister pumps were installed by the same contractor in the same outage. What should the FRACAS action include beyond repairing the failed pump?
We were discussing a crusher. Now I want to onboard a new Cat 797 haul truck. Do not reuse the crusher facts. Give me the onboarding framework.

A protective bearing-temperature trip occurred once on a critical turbine. The signal spike is real in the historian, but sensor health and corroborating vibration are unknown. Explain severity versus confidence and the next action.
